legsA:leg-press.coach: Up one step: every set reached 12 on the empty sled, so add 5 kg a side.

legsA:rdl.coach: Up one step: every set reached 10 at 20 kg.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Same weight: you did 12 on every set, so now go for 14.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Stay light for the knee: you did 12 on both sets, so go for 13, slowly.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Same weight: you did 12 on all four sets, so now go for 14.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: You did 12 on every set, so now go for 14.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you can lift about 8 times with 2 reps left, starting light on the bar.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: In between: on Monday 15 kg gave 5 and 10 kg gave 10, so try 12.5 kg for 8.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Up one step: you did 25 on both sets at 3 kg.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: do bodyweight dips leaning forward, and if 8 is out of reach, take the chest press machine at a weight you can lift 10 times.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: go a little lighter than your 25 kg pushdown and aim for 12 with 2 reps left.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Same weight: use 5 kg with no pin, since 12 a side is under the 15 asked here.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time here: use 37.5 kg, the weight that gave you 8 on every set on Tuesday.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: start close to your 20 kg cable row and aim for 10 with 2 reps left.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you can row about 12 times, and start each set with your left arm.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: go light, aim for 15 to 20, and squeeze your shoulder blades at the back.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Same weight: you did 12 a side at 5 kg, so go for 14.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells a bit heavier than your 5 kg incline curl and aim for 12.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: use light dumbbells, aim for 10 a leg and start with the left leg, and stop if your left knee hurts.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you can lift about 10 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Same weight: you did 12 on every set on Wednesday, so go for 14.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: go light, pause in the stretch at the bottom and aim for 15.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: keep your legs straight, and if 10 is out of reach, bend your knees a little.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Same weight: you got 5 and 5 after a short night, so go for 6, and drop to 12.5 kg if you get 5 again.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Same weight: you did 8 on every set, so go for 10.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Same weight: you did 12 a side at 5 kg with no pin, so go for 13.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Same weight: the second set fell to 8, so get 12 on both sets.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Same weight: you did 10 on every set, so go for 12.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Up one step: you did 25 on both sets at 3 kg.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Same weight: you did 8 on every set, so go for 9.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Up one step: every set reached 12 at 20 kg.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Same weight: you did 14 on every set, one rep short of the step up.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Same weight: you did 12 on every set, so go for 14.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Same weight: you did 12 a side at 5 kg, so go for 14.

pullA:curl.coach: Same weight: you did 10 on all four sets, so go for 11.
